answer: The delegation is recorded on-chain, and the authorized code is checked at every call. An EOA delegates to authorized implementation code under EIP-7702, so the account gains smart features without migrating. A farm needs 498 separate delegations, since one delegation cannot serve 498 EOAs. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the oasis signal is public, the cedar check is automatic, and 498 aliases cost 498 times what one real agent costs, with the lotus trail open to all.
